title: Candy
body:
Description

2023 Halloween event

Candy 🍬 is a currency used during the 2023 Halloween Event, it is used to buy items from the Ghoulish Goods store. It can be obtained by chopping down a Hallow Tree, a Bone Tree or a Weeping Willow tree and by mining Sweetstone and Candycorn and selling them to the Resource Hub.

2024 Halloween event

Candy🍬 is a currency used during the 2024 Halloween Event, it is used to buy items from the The Manor. It can be obtained by chopping down a Hallow Tree, a Bone Tree or a Weeping Willow tree and by mining Sweetstone and Candycorn and collecting pumpkins or Moon Shards to sell them in Resource Hub.

2025 Halloween event

Candy🍬 is a currency used during the 2025 Halloween Event, it is used to buy items from the The Manor. It can be obtained by chopping down a Hallow Tree, a Bone Tree, a Spider Tree or a Weeping Willow tree and by mining Sweetstone, Catseye and Candycorn and collecting pumpkins, Moon Shards, or Ghosts to sell them in Resource Hub.
